description: Verify generated public-source row families before storage: source records exist, normalized objects point to sources, entity refs point to known entities, dedupe clusters include known members, labels and dimensions attach to known objects, embedding stubs match known objects, and review tickets point to known objects.

Score candidate primitives emitted from public-source replay rows using provenance, review status, content hash, privacy boundary, freshness, source governance, and high-risk review triggers before any promotion to canonical search surfaces.
Convert validated public-source row-family JSONL and promotion rows into CSV staging files plus a psql load script for Postgres and pgvector-compatible canonical storage.

Keep raw captures, private records, scraped source bodies, proprietary source dumps, and insurance-scoped rows out of the public catalog; route volatile legal, health, safety, AML, moderation, and consumer-impacting objects to curator review before promotion.
